content.text: Question: I'm migrating an STM32F407 LQFP100 board from silicon revision A to revision Z. Does the PDR_ON connection need to change, and can I continue using a 1.7 V supply?

generation.answer: No modification is required when migrating to other device revisions for PDR_ON connection [Page 1]. However, it is no longer possible to supply the product from a 1.7 V VDD on LQFP100 package since VDD minimum value is 1.8 V when the POR/PDR feature is enabled [Page 2].
